_comment: Your exact scenario, decomposed. Player 'Jordan Rivera' goes 3-for-4. Each batted ball carries full contact detail AND the base/out/score state it happened in. The box-score line and every situational split at the bottom are DERIVED from these four events, not entered by hand.

plate_appearances.plain_english: Scorched line drive to center, 2 on — single, drives in a run.
Shallow blooper that dropped in beyond short, nobody on, no outs — cheap single.
Second scorched liner to center, 2 on — splits the gap for a 2-RBI double.

batted_ball.note: hit_hard_out — crushed it, right at the right fielder

plate_appearances.plain_english: Rocket to right, bases loaded, 2 out — the right fielder caught it. A hard-hit OUT (bad luck, tracked as such).

derived_situational.hard_hit_pct: 0.75  (3 of 4 balls in play were hard/scorched)
derived_situational.hard_hit_outs: 1  (the RF rocket — not reflected in AVG, but real quality)
derived_situational.spray_tendency: 3 of 4 to CF/RF — pulling nothing, driving the ball middle-away

_note: Every number in derived_box_line and derived_situational is a pure function of plate_appearances. Add a new split (e.g. 'vs 90+ mph fastballs') and it computes from the same four events — no recapture.
